listing.name: Need a little advice from seasoned modders

description:
Hello!
I'm an ordinary Star sector player.
I've enjoyed the game all these years, but now, with the update coming out, I decided to try my hand at modding by creating a small mod for myself and my friends.
The mod isn't complicated; it just changes the parameters of a number of ships back to their previous state (we didn't like the nerfs to our favorite ships).
I successfully changed the parameters of ships like Paragon and Onslaught by copying ship_data.csv to my mod folder, modifying it, and by using the following command in mod_info.json "replace": ["data/hulls/ship_data.csv"]. Specifically, I reverted the OP parameter back to the value from the previous patch.

After that, I went to change the Onslaught XIV settings through the skins file. The modified file onslaught_xiv.skin looks like this:
{
"baseHullId": "onslaught",
"skinHullId": "onslaught_xiv",
"ordnancePoints": 370,
"builtInMods": ["fourteenth"]
}
The goal was to remove the Armored weapon mounts mod from the ones built in. But, when I'm opening the codex, that mod is still there. What am I doing wrong?

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A6xJ-ifrsr6SNpo09qP5DdQpkbn-tLUe/view?usp=sharing
